hotels.title: Basingstoke City Stay Minutes from Railway Station
hotels.description: Surrounded by tranquil wooded greenery and only minutes from transportation and urban streets, Crowne Plaza Basingstoke, an IHG Hotel, is a verdant refuge with easy access to the city. Wake your body up at the fully-equipped fitness centre or melt away tense muscles in the sauna and steam room. Enjoy modern and creative dishes and a refined cocktail at 1449 Restaurant, Bar and Grill or consider heading into the city centre to experience vibrant restaurants, bars and retail.
